english.title: Fail to comply with the requirements for dealing with specified risk material
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person with animals placed under an official movement restriction, failed to comply with the requirements for dealing with specified risk material in Article 8 and Annex 5 of the EU TSE Regulation and Schedule 7 to the Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (England) Regulations 2018, in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(6)(f) and 18(1)(a) and (2) of the Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (England) Regulations 2018.
